message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the facts and determine which crimes are directly supported. The facts: dumping hazardous waste (acid) with heavy metals, causing environmental pollution. The relevant Chinese criminal law provisions: "非法倾倒、处置危险废物罪" (illegal dumping of hazardous waste) under Article 338 of Criminal Law (formerly Article 338? Actually Article 338 of the Criminal Law of PRC deals with illegal dumping of hazardous waste). Also possibly "污染环境罪" (environmental pollution crime) under Article 338 (or 339?). Let's recall: In China, Article 338 (formerly 338) of Criminal Law: "违反国家规定，非法倾倒、处置危险废物，情节严重的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节特别严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" That's the crime of illegal dumping of hazardous waste. Also there is "污染环境罪" under Article 338? Actually "污染环境罪" is Article 338 (old) but after amendment, "非法倾倒、处置危险废物罪" is Article 338. There is also "非法排放、倾倒有毒有害物质罪" maybe. The facts mention "倾倒废酸" with heavy metals, causing pollution of land. So the crime is "非法倾倒、处置危险废物罪". Also possibly "污染环境罪" (environmental pollution) but the law lumps them. The question: "请只针对这部分列出它构成的罪名。" So we list crimes directly supported by this part. The main crime is illegal dumping of hazardous waste. Could also be "危害公共安全罪"? No, that's for causing explosion etc. Not here.

Thus answer: [罪名]非法倾倒、处置危险废物罪<eoa>

If multiple, maybe also "污染环境罪". But the law: Article 338 (as of 2011 amendment) is "非法倾倒、处置危险废物罪". The older "污染环境罪" is Article 338 (pre-2011). The question likely expects "非法倾倒、处置危险废物罪". So output that.
